title: Pyramids as generators of plasma energy

tellings.quote: I do think I do think that it had something to do with the uh generation of some kind of energy. And if I had to pick an energy I would say plasma energy.

plain: The pyramids of Giza, in Egypt, were built to generate some kind of energy, most likely plasma energy, an electrically charged state of matter. That is the view of a researcher named Randall Carlson, who gives it as his own opinion without naming a source, though he mentions a man named Bob Greener. If he were right, the pyramids would have been machines rather than only tombs.
